subject: Muse scored against its rivals
headline: Muse isn't ChatGPT. There are now three kinds of AI, and Meta's is built for everyone.

files.name: 1-three-kinds-of-ai.png
files.purpose: Three kinds of AI. Chatbots, ChatGPT or Claude. Work agents, Claude Cowork. Ready-made assistants run your errands, Muse by Meta and Siri by Apple. Not a fair fight.

files.name: 2-who-pays.png
files.purpose: Each company builds the kind that makes it money. Almost all of Meta's money comes from ads. OpenAI and Anthropic charge office workers a monthly fee.

files.name: 3-the-scorecard.png
files.purpose: I scored Muse against Siri on six things. Muse and Siri tie on 43 out of 60, for opposite reasons. Siri keeps your stuff private.

files.name: 4-who-can-read-it.png
files.purpose: Muse falls behind Siri. Muse keeps your emails and passwords on Meta's computers. Meta says it can still look at them.

files.name: 5-each-shop-decides.png
files.purpose: Muse can shop for you. Each shop decides whether to let Muse buy on its website. Walmart lets it in. Amazon blocked Muse. WhatsApp bookings.

files.name: 6-prediction.png
files.purpose: My prediction. By the end of 2027, a big airline signs a deal with Meta and Apple. Only Muse and Siri can sell its tickets.
